tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get the full markdown content of a blog post by its slug. Returns title, description, dates, tags, and the raw markdown body.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Get information about suganthan.com, the author, and topics covered.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List all published blog posts on suganthan.com with titles, slugs, URLs, dates, descriptions, and tags. Sorted by recency.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search published blog posts on suganthan.com by keyword. Matches against title, description, and tags. Returns up to 20 results sorted by recency.
